headline: Adam told you that your blood thinner (anticoagulant) was prescribed by mistake at a higher dose than you needed, and that this may have contributed to your knee bleed after ACL surgery.

followUps.title: Get the complaint form from Adam
followUps.detail: Adam will give you a form to make a formal complaint to the liaison service. A family member can help you fill it in.

followUps.title: Have your questions ready for Adam later today
followUps.detail: Adam said they will come back and speak to you later today. If you think of more questions, write them down before then.

instructions.text: Keep going with your rehab. You will continue the physio work on your knee.

openQuestions.text: How the higher dose came to be prescribed by mistake was not fully explained to you.
Whether the blood thinner caused your bleed is not confirmed. Adam said it might have caused or contributed to it.
